fix_subject: Fix a hang when enable_logging fails part-way, and make enable_logging restore the previous settings on failure
pr_title: Merge #26571: Fix a hang when enable_logging fails part-way, and make enable_logging restore the previous settings on failure

labels.summary: When enable_logging failed partway, an exception in QueryResult::CompleteInternal destroyed the result while the context lock was held, and closing it re-locked the context and hung; the fix cleans up with the held lock, restores the previous logging config on failure, and rejects unknown log types at bind time.
